answer.justification: The itchy annular erythematous plaque with KOH-positive hyphae is tinea corporis. Management requires an antifungal, not antibiotics (C, D). Itraconazole is an appropriate dermatophyte azole; griseofulvin is mainly for tinea capitis and is less preferred for limited body tinea when an azole is available.
